toolchains.rust: Rust 1.99.0 Windows GNU host, wasm32-unknown-unknown / wasm-bindgen 0.2.126 / Emscripten Clang for zstd / LLVM-MinGW 20261006 for host tools

vba-next.method: Independent rebuild from the distributed compiler-dependency source archive in another directory; Emscripten 4.0.15.

melonds.method: Independent clean build from a fresh separate extraction of the distributed archive plus updated lid bridge; Emscripten 4.0.15. Both JS/WASM match.
melonds.changes: Boot-time language, five-second blowing via L2 and held lid position via L3. Core, battery/state layouts unchanged. melonDS 0.9.3 does not serialize KeyInput, so state loads retain current physical lid position. Authored ARM7 hinge and old/new state compatibility pass.

jgenesis.method: Independent offline build after moving the first tree aside and extracting the distribution archive into the same absolute build path; no target/object cache reused. Cargo crate identifiers vary with source paths, so a separate-path build is not byte-identical.
jgenesis.changes: Two player inputs for NES/SNES/MD only. GB remains single player because its set_field ignores the player argument. Snapshot/battery formats unchanged. Explicit SNES/MD second gamepad; aliased MD buttons combined with OR.

tests: tests/multicore.cjs: original synthetic programs, input/stylus, state reset and restore, malformed-state rejection, battery import/export/reset, per-core storage and original-data preservation. See RELEASE_VALIDATION.md.
